source_text: Non abscondam ab Abraham quae facturus sum. Numerus iustorum — quinquaginta usque ad decem — sustentat civitatem. Intercessio iusti.
pass_a_gloss: Not I-will-hide from Abraham what about-to-do I-am. Number of-just — fifty as-far-as to ten — upholds city. Intercession of-just-one.
pass_b_english: [[Shall I hide from Abraham what I am about to do? >> Bible:Genesis 18:17]] The count of the just — [[fifty down to ten >> Bible:Genesis 18:24-32]] — upholds the city. The just one’s intercession.
